rationale: The UI notice covers production npm variants for targets exercised by the dependency-audit and container support surfaces. GitHub release packaging is recorded separately and is only a subset.

audit.purpose: The security audit checks temporary Rust pins on these compilation targets; it is not a release matrix.

container.purpose: The container selects architecture-specific Linux cloudflared binaries for these BuildKit architectures.

release.purpose: The tag release currently packages only Linux x86_64; it does not prove the other four notice targets.
